context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset functionality fully implemented and tested. Both backend APIs (POST /api/admins/{admin_id}/reset-password and POST /api/workers/{worker_id}/reset-password) work correctly. Frontend UI shows key icon button that opens password reset dialog with proper validation.

POST /api/workers.details: Create new worker with name, username, password

POST /api/workers/{id}/reset-password.details: Reset worker password - validates min 6 chars, invalidates sessions

POST /api/admins.details: Create new admin with name, username, email, password

POST /api/admins/{id}/reset-password.details: Reset admin password - validates min 6 chars, invalidates sessions

Frontend: AdminsPage.details: Shows admin cards with key icon (password reset) and trash icon (delete). Password reset dialog works correctly.

Frontend: WorkersPage.details: Shows worker cards with Deactiveren/Activeren toggle, key icon (password reset), and trash icon (delete). All dialogs work correctly.
